ev_tree_canopy_cover_sprenkle24_2.note: The 27% is a pooled expert estimate of achievable maximum tree cover without yield loss, not an existing-canopy suitability breakpoint. Retained for design/target assessment with biome and system disaggregation required.

ev_tree_canopy_cover_sprenkle24_4.note: The 21% and 42% values belong to different biomes. Removed invented optimum band; retained separate biome target estimates, including source caveat against transferring species-dependent maxima.

ev_t4_precip_ahmad17_1.note: Table 5 rainfall ranks are a regional classification, not a universal optimum starting at 985 mm. All original classes retained; membership and transfer unresolved.

ev_t4_tcc_brandt2015_1.note: Tree cover below 10% targets low-cover cropland against a Kenya national tree-cover target. Removed false biophysical maximum; retained explicit policy/scenario evidence.

ev_t4_mat_castle2025_1.note: Source Table 2 defines frost-free period in days, not mean annual temperature. Retagged to existing VONT frost_free_period; selection evidence only, no numerical threshold.

ev_T4_ph_haile2024_1.note: Regional nutrient-class table contains overlapping/reversed ranges. Preserved all source ranks rather than extracting highest class as a generic pH optimum. Requires source-table ambiguity and applicability review.

EV_lohbeck_2020_001.note: Review discussion describes where adoption evidence exists and explicitly calls for research outside these conditions. Removed 100-950 mm physiological limits.

EV_lohbeck_2020_002.note: Review ecological-context section describes reported practice distribution. Removed hard limits; retained cited observations.

EV_weston_2015_001.note: Weston describes West African development regions from Sahelian 250-500 mm to Sudanian up to 1000 mm. Old 500 mm maximum truncated the same sentence; none of these values is an establishment limit.

EV_wri_regreening_2015_001.note: WRI p54 (PDF p58) advises where to target rapid results. Regreening occurs below 400 mm; 400-800 mm describes greatest spread. Removed hard minimum and invented optimum bounds; retained observed context and qualitative growth response.

EV_wocat_1358_2017_001.note: Same WOCAT Natural Environment panel as approved slope correction: selected rainfall classes describe this technology site. Removed shape parameters, retained site climate.
